pr_title: Validate the types of sequence inputs to JavaInfo
pr_body:
Starlark does not check the types of generic parameters (e.g.
Sequence<T>), so we must do this manually so as to raise a neater error
message.

Fixes #11457

issue_context.title: Unhandled exception in JavaInfo type error
issue_context.body:
Reproduction case:
```
def _impl(ctx):
    f = ctx.actions.declare_file("out")
    ctx.actions.write(f, "out")
    return JavaInfo(
        output_jar = f,
        compile_jar = f,
        runtime_deps = [f],
    )
```

This will die with:
```
Internal error thrown during build. Printing stack trace: java.lang.RuntimeException: Unrecoverable error while evaluating node '//:test BuildConfigurationValue.Key[dbadffe9d0533bf51e2ba2aac08b5435397cdb67cd0b74b86e24900343122bb0] false' (requested by nodes )
	at com.google.devtools.build.skyframe.AbstractParallelEvaluator$Evaluate.run(AbstractParallelEvaluator.java:515)
	at com.google.devtools.build.lib.concurrent.AbstractQueueVisitor$WrappedRunnable.run(AbstractQueueVisitor.java:399)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinTask$AdaptedRunnableAction.exec(Unknown Source)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinTask.doExec(Unknown Source)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool$WorkQueue.topLevelExec(Unknown Source)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.scan(Unknown Source)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.runWorker(Unknown Source)
	at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinWorkerThread.run(Unknown Source)
Caused by: java.lang.ClassCastException: class com.google.devtools.build.lib.actions.Artifact$DerivedArtifact cannot be cast to class com.google.devtools.build.lib.rules.java.JavaInfo (com.google.devtools.build.lib.actions.Artifact$DerivedArtifact and com.google.devtools.build.lib.rules.java.JavaInfo are in unnamed module of loader 'app')
```

The reproduction code is incorrect: runtime_deps requires list of JavaInfo, not list of File. The error should be caught by starlark, not fall through to an unhandled exception.

review_comments: you probably want to replace `runtime_deps` with `exports` here
